The Beijing municipal tourism page identifies the Palace Museum as a national museum and historic palace complex and lists peak-season general admission at CNY 60 per person for April 1 to October 31, which covers the frozen September window.
The official EDO-TOKYO MUSEUM ticket page lists individual adult permanent-exhibition admission at 800 yen.

The official Seoul Museum of History visitor page lists general admission as free, so the rule moves to the next-ranked paid historic site. The Seoul Metropolitan Government Changdeokgung Palace page lists adult admission at KRW 3,000.
The official National Museum, New Delhi visiting page lists the foreign-adult general admission ticket at Rs. 500. This replaces the National Zoological Park ticket.
The Sri Lankan Department of National Museums ticket-pricing page lists the Colombo National Museum general foreign-adult ticket at US$5.
The museum's official visit page lists the Indian adult visitor museum-entry ticket at Rs 200, effective from 1 May 2025.
The official museum hours-and-prices page lists the adult entry ticket at 1000 TL.
The official Museum of the Future visit page lists the entry ticket for visitors aged 4 and above at AED 169.
The Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities page lists the foreign adult ticket at EGP 550.
Iziko's 2026 fee notice lists the international adult fee for the Iziko South African Museum at R100, effective 1 April 2026.
The National Museums of Kenya 2026 admission-fee notice lists the Nairobi National Museum foreign-adult fee at US$18.
The official Hungarian National Museum ticket page lists the full-price adult ticket for its permanent exhibitions at HUF 3,500. This replaces the exhibition-specific Kunsthalle ticket.

observations.sourceName: Museum Complex of the National Museum
observations.evidenceText: The official National Museum Prague page lists a standard adult ticket of CZK 360 for the Museum Complex, valid for all current and long-term exhibitions.
The Portuguese museum page lists the museum entrance ticket at 10 euros and identifies the Lisbon ticket-office address.
The official Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya page lists general admission to the museum collection at 12 euros. This replaces the exhibition-specific private-foundation ticket.
The official Mexico City museum page lists the general adult admission fee at MXN 60; Sundays are free for all visitors.
The Peruvian Ministry of Culture museum page lists the foreign-adult admission fee at S/.40.

observations.sourceName: San Francisco Museum of Modern Art
observations.evidenceText: SFMOMA's official visitor guide lists general admission for an adult at US$30.

NGV general admission is free, so the next-ranked paid museum is Melbourne Museum. The official Museums Victoria visitor page lists Melbourne Museum adult entry at $18 and states that extra charges apply only to temporary exhibitions and special events.
